rule.name: nodeIntegration Enabled in Renderer Process
rule.rule_desc: Browser or embedded-renderer configuration relaxes an isolation or content-execution control. Determine which external content can reach the affected context.
rule.vuln_desc: Untrusted page content may cross an intended browser or renderer boundary, execute privileged operations, or access protected data when the relaxed control exposes those capabilities.
rule.developer: Restore origin and process isolation, keep privileged APIs out of untrusted renderers, and use a restrictive content-security policy without unnecessary unsafe execution directives.
rule.reviewer: Confirm nodeIntegration: false is set for all BrowserWindow instances that load remote content or user-supplied URLs. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.vuln_desc: Untrusted page content may cross an intended browser or renderer boundary, execute privileged operations, or access protected data when the relaxed control exposes those capabilities.
rule.developer: Restore origin and process isolation, keep privileged APIs out of untrusted renderers, and use a restrictive content-security policy without unnecessary unsafe execution directives.

rule.name: allowRunningInsecureContent Enabled
rule.rule_desc: An embedded browser permits active insecure content within a secure page.
rule.vuln_desc: A network attacker may replace cleartext scripts or other active content and run it in the page’s trusted context, potentially exposing session data or privileged renderer functionality.
rule.developer: Disallow active mixed content and load all executable resources through authenticated HTTPS. Keep renderer privileges isolated from untrusted pages.
rule.reviewer: Confirm mixed content loading is not allowed in production. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Remote Module Usage (Deprecated)
rule.rule_desc: The source references a dependency, version, or deprecated API. Resolve the actual deployed version and supported behavior before deciding whether it needs replacement.
rule.vuln_desc: A reachable vulnerability in an unsupported or affected dependency may compromise the application with its privileges. A version declaration or deprecated API alone does not establish that such a vulnerability is present.
rule.developer: Inventory resolved dependencies and runtime versions, compare them with authoritative advisories and support policy, and migrate affected or unsupported components to tested supported replacements.
rule.reviewer: Confirm remote module usage has been migrated to explicit IPC patterns. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.
